text.title: CLAUDE.md Creation (Quality) — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact is the committed root CLAUDE.md plus this JSON record of how it satisfies 01-core-rules.xml: a secret scan clean and wired into CI and pre-commit, every command verbatim and exiting 0 on a fresh clone, a numeric line budget declared in the first comment and held under a CI check, repository content imported within five hops rather than pasted, personal content kept local, per-package rules in subdirectory files, every prohibition carrying its consequence with emphasis on at most one line in four, and every referenced path existing under a CI check. A named reviewer approves. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: single-package or multi-package; multi-package requires subdir_files (r-claude-md-subdir-scoping)
line_budget declared in the first comment (100 is the workable default), line_count, within_budget true, ci_line_check true (r-claude-md-line-budget)
scanner, runs in CI and pre-commit, clean true, secrets referenced by env var or vault item name (r-claude-md-no-secrets)
each invocation verbatim and copy-pasteable with exit_code 0 on a fresh clone (r-claude-md-commands-verbatim)
every @path import with exists true and hop_depth at most 5; pasted_repo_content false (r-claude-md-import-not-paste)
no personal content in the committed file; CLAUDE.local.md gitignored (r-claude-md-personal-goes-local)
for multi-package layouts: each package's own CLAUDE.md with exists true; root_has_per_package_commands false (r-claude-md-subdir-scoping)
each never / do-not line with consequence_stated true and whether it carries emphasis; emphasis_ratio at most 0.25 (r-claude-md-prohibitions-argued)
CI job that extracts referenced paths and fails when any is missing; all_refs_exist true (r-claude-md-refs-exist)
role:handle of the named reviewer who approved the PR after the three checks were green
URLs: the CI run with secret scan, line check and path check; the PR

forbidden.pattern: secrets.clean false, or a scanner that runs in CI but not pre-commit (fm-secret-in-brief)
a command described in prose ("run the tests") or with exit_code other than 0 (fm-stale-commands)
root_file.within_budget false, or no budget declared in the first comment (fm-readme-pasted)
imports.pasted_repo_content true, or an import with hop_depth above 5 (fm-readme-pasted)
layout multi-package with root_has_per_package_commands true or no subdir_files (fm-monorepo-root-dump)
a prohibition with consequence_stated false, or emphasis_ratio above 0.25 (fm-emphasis-inflation)
refs_check.all_refs_exist false, or no reviewer (fm-stale-commands; human checkpoint)

allowed-transformations.transformation: Where a referenced doc would exceed five import hops, link it as a plain path with a one-line description and record it in imports with hop_depth of the link, not the chain.
Where a command needs an environment (a venv, a container), record the invocation exactly as run in CI, including the wrapper.
Count emphasis_ratio over non-empty lines of the committed file; blank lines and code fences do not count.

list.item: The scanner runs in CI and pre-commit, the file is clean, and every secret is referenced by env var or vault item name.
Every command is a verbatim invocation that exited 0 on a fresh clone at this commit.
The first comment declares a numeric line budget, wc -l is within it, and CI fails when it is not.
Repository content is imported with @path within five hops, never pasted; every import exists.
No machine paths, local ports or personal habits are in the committed file; CLAUDE.local.md is gitignored.
In a multi-package repository every package has its own CLAUDE.md and the root carries no per-package commands.
Every never / do-not line states its consequence; emphasis markers sit on at most one line in four.
A CI check extracts every referenced path and all exist; a named reviewer approved the PR.
